missing: Independent hands-on testing of vertical stands. This means measured slot range with cases, tip resistance with heavy laptops, scratch risk and heat in closed-lid use, and the manufacturer's guidance on closed-lid cooling for specific laptops.
why: No major reviewer or authority covers vertical stands. WIRED covers only tilted stands. The vertical-specific sources are mostly affiliate roundups with similar picks (OMOTON, UGREEN, Psitek). Only Rigworthy gives usable spec-based comparisons, and it is a small site with no visible testing data.
